blobs.releaseWorkflowSha256:
name: Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        {
          description: Release tag for the candidate or published crate handoff,
          required: true,
          type: string,
        }
      release_pr:
        description: Release PR number (empty for the manual crate handoff)
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact validated release PR commit
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      pinned:
        description: Publish an immutable source cut after a protected version integration
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      crate_set:
        {
          description: Manual handoff crate set to publish,
          required: true,
          default: jsx-patina,
          type: choice,
          options: [jsx-patina],
        }
run-name: >-
  ${{ inputs.release_pr != '' && (inputs.pinned && format('Pinned Release {0} PR #{1} @ {2}', inputs.tag_name, inputs.release_pr, inputs.expected_sha) || format('Release {0} PR #{1} @ {2}', inputs.tag_name, inputs.release_pr, inputs.expected_sha)) || format('Release crate handoff {0}', inputs.tag_name) }}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ inputs.release_pr != '' && 'release-candidates' || format('release-crates-handoff-{0}-{1}', inputs.tag_name, inputs.crate_set) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions: { contents: read }
env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
  PUBLISH_RETRY_LIMIT: 6
  PUBLISH_RETRY_DELAY: 10
  PUBLISH_RESOLUTION_RETRY_LIMIT: 60
  PUBLISH_RESOLUTION_RETRY_DELAY: 10
  NPM_TAG: ${{ contains(inputs.tag_name, '-alpha') && 'alpha' || contains(inputs.tag_name, '-beta') && 'beta' || contains(inputs.tag_name, '-rc') && 'rc' || 'latest' }}
jobs:
  candidate:
    if: inputs.release_pr != ''
    name: Authorize release candidate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: read, pull-requests: read }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@02cb101ec7c40f2c49e1d9714d64511d8e1b74de # master
        with: { toolchain: stable }
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust-script
      - name: Verify author, current main and exact PR commit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR: ${{ inputs.release_pr }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag_name }}
          RELEASE_PINNED: ${{ inputs.pinned }}
        run: |
          if [ "$RELEASE_PINNED" = true ]; then
            rust-script tools/commands/release/pr.rs validate-pinned "$RELEASE_PR" "$RELEASE_SHA" "$RELEASE_TAG"
          else
            rust-script tools/commands/release/pr.rs validate "$RELEASE_PR" "$RELEASE_SHA" "$RELEASE_TAG"
          fi
  plan-release-platforms:
    if: inputs.release_pr != ''
    needs: candidate
    name: Plan release platforms
    runs-on: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      include_slow_platforms: ${{ steps.platforms.outputs.include_slow_platforms }}
      release_minor: ${{ steps.platforms.outputs.release_minor }}
      cli_matrix: ${{ steps.platforms.outputs.cli_matrix }}
      native_matrix: ${{ steps.platforms.outputs.native_matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d1031067263f94b142dd6c0ce24c5eb9d02d52a0 # stable
        with: { toolchain: stable }
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust-script
      - name: Select release platforms
        id: platforms
        env:
          RELEASE_REF_NAME: ${{ inputs.tag_name }}
        run: rust-script tools/commands/ci/github/release-platforms.rs github-output "$RELEASE_REF_NAME"
  build-cli:
    name: Build CLI - ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
    needs: plan-release-platforms
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.settings.host }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        settings: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan-release-platforms.outputs.cli_matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with: { node-version-file: "package.json", package-manager-cache: false }
      - name: Enable long paths (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: git config --system core.longpaths true
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d1031067263f94b142dd6c0ce24c5eb9d02d52a0 # stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
      - name: Install Rust target
        run: rustup target add ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust-script
      - name: Setup Wild linker (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && !endsWith(matrix.settings.target, '-musl')
        uses: wild-linker/action@0bbbfa5df4380cab8e63cb8505a1ce65e1d10203 # v0.9.0
        with:
          wild-version: "0.9.0"
      - name: Stabilize Ubuntu package archive (Linux ARM64)
        if: matrix.settings.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ubuntu-archive
      - name: Install cross-compilation tools (Linux ARM64)
        if: matrix.settings.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: vize-ci-apt-retry node tools/support/github/install-cross-compile-tools.ts

        if: endsWith(matrix.settings.target, '-musl')
        uses: goto-bus-stop/setup-zig@abea47f85e598557f500fa1fd2ab7464fcb39406 # v2
      - name: Configure Zig linker (Linux musl CLI)
        if: endsWith(matrix.settings.target, '-musl')
        run: rust-script tools/commands/ci/github/configure-zig-musl-linkers.rs
      - name: Mount Rust sticky disks (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust-sticky-cache
        with:
          # Release binaries build from a fresh checkout without reused run state.
          reuse-target: "false"
          key: release-cli-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          cache-key-suffix: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
      - name: Cache Rust (non-Linux)
        if: runner.os != 'Linux'
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@e18b497796c12c097a38f9edb9d0641fb99eee32 # v2
        with:
          shared-key: release-cli-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          cache-workspace-crates: "true"
          save-if: "false"
      - name: Tune Windows release profile
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=thin" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build CLI
        shell: bash
        env:
          CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER: aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc
        run: cargo build --release -p vize --target ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
      - name: Create archive (Unix)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: if [[ "${{ matrix.settings.target }}" == *-musl ]]; then rust-script tools/commands/ci/github/verify-musl-cli-binary.rs "${{ matrix.settings.target }}"; fi; node tools/support/github/create-cli-archive.ts ${{ matrix.settings.target }} ${{ matrix.settings.archive }} vize
      - name: Create archive (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/support/github/create-cli-archive.ts ${{ matrix.settings.target }} ${{ matrix.settings.archive }} vize.exe
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          {
            name: "cli-${{ matrix.settings.target }}",
            path: "${{ matrix.settings.archive }}",
            if-no-files-found: error,
            compression-level: 0,
          }

    if: inputs.release_pr != ''

    name: Build Editor Extensions
    runs-on: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
      - uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@ca1c46663915d6c1042ae23bd39ab85718bfb0fa # v1
        with: { node-version-file: "package.json", cache: true, run-install: false }
      - name: Install JS dependencies
        run: vp install --workspace-root --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d1031067263f94b142dd6c0ce24c5eb9d02d52a0 # stable
        with: { toolchain: stable }
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust-sticky-cache
        with:

        with: { node-version-file: "package.json", run-install: false }

    env: { RELEASE_TAG_NAME: "${{ inputs.tag_name }}" }
    timeout-minutes: 20

    permissions:

    steps:

      - name: List CLI artifacts
        run: ls -la cli-artifacts/
      - name: List editor extension artifacts
        run: find editor-extension-artifacts -maxdepth 5 -type f | sort
      # Publish CycloneDX and SPDX SBOMs for dependency auditing.
      - name: Generate workspace SBOM (CycloneDX)
        uses: anchore/sbom-action@61119d458adab75f756bc0b9e4bde25725f86a7a # v0.17.8
        with:
          artifact-name: vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-cyclonedx.sbom.json
          format: cyclonedx-json
          output-file: vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-cyclonedx.sbom.json
          upload-artifact: false
      - name: Generate workspace SBOM (SPDX)
        uses: anchore/sbom-action@61119d458adab75f756bc0b9e4bde25725f86a7a # v0.17.8
        with:
          artifact-name: vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-spdx.sbom.json
          format: spdx-json
          output-file: vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-spdx.sbom.json
          upload-artifact: false
      # Sign artifacts with the workflow OIDC identity and Sigstore.
      - name: Install cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@dc72c7d5c4d10cd6bcb8cf6e3fd625a9e5e537da # v3.7.0
        with:
          cosign-release: v2.4.1
      # Publish SHA-256 checksums alongside signatures and certificates.
      - name: Generate SHA-256 checksums for release artifacts
        run: |
          for artifact in \
            cli-artifacts/*.tar.gz \
            cli-artifacts/*.zip \
            editor-extension-artifacts/editors/vscode/dist/*.vsix \
            editor-extension-artifacts/*.tar.gz; do
            if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
              echo "Hashing $artifact"
              ( cd "$(dirname "$artifact")" && sha256sum "$(basename "$artifact")" ) > "${artifact}.sha256"
            fi
          done
      - name: Sign release artifacts (keyless)
        env:
          COSIGN_YES: "true"
        run: |
          for artifact in \
            cli-artifacts/*.tar.gz \
            cli-artifacts/*.zip \
            editor-extension-artifacts/editors/vscode/dist/*.vsix \
            editor-extension-artifacts/*.tar.gz \
            vize-${RELEASE_TAG_NAME}-cyclonedx.sbom.json \
            vize-${RELEASE_TAG_NAME}-spdx.sbom.json; do
            if [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
              echo "Signing $artifact"
              cosign sign-blob --yes \
                --bundle "${artifact}.cosign.bundle" \
                --output-certificate "${artifact}.pem" \
                --output-signature "${artifact}.sig" \
                "$artifact"
            fi
          done
      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@3bb12739c298aeb8a4eeaf626c5b8d85266b0e65 # v2
        with:
          body_path: .github/release-notes/drop-in-scope.md
          generate_release_notes: true
          draft: false
          overwrite_files: true
          tag_name: ${{ inputs.tag_name }}
          prerelease: ${{ contains(inputs.tag_name, 'alpha') || contains(inputs.tag_name, 'beta') || contains(inputs.tag_name, 'rc') }}
          files: |
            cli-artifacts/*.tar.gz
            cli-artifacts/*.zip
            editor-extension-artifacts/editors/vscode/dist/*.vsix
            editor-extension-artifacts/*.tar.gz
            vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-cyclonedx.sbom.json
            vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-spdx.sbom.json
            cli-artifacts/*.sha256
            cli-artifacts/*.sig
            cli-artifacts/*.pem
            cli-artifacts/*.cosign.bundle
            editor-extension-artifacts/**/*.sha256
            editor-extension-artifacts/**/*.sig
            editor-extension-artifacts/**/*.pem
            editor-extension-artifacts/**/*.cosign.bundle
            vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-*.sig
            vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-*.pem
            vize-${{ inputs.tag_name }}-*.cosign.bundle

blobs.workflowSha256:
name: Release JSR
# Publishes `@vizejs/vize` to JSR after the same version is public on npm, then
# installs the published package from JSR in fresh Node, Deno and Bun projects.
# Every release runs the publish dry-run against the just-published npm
# packages. The real publication and the consumers wait for
# `jsr/vize/channel.json` to enable them.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Published npm release version or tag
        required: true
        type: string
      source_sha:
        description: Release source commit
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Published npm release version or tag
        required: true
        type: string
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: release-jsr-${{ inputs.version }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  channel:
    name: Read the JSR channel
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      enabled: ${{ steps.channel.outputs.enabled }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with: { node-version: "24", package-manager-cache: false }
      - id: channel
        run: node tools/support/release/jsr/package.ts channel >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  publish:
    name: Publish the JSR package
    needs: channel
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with: { node-version: "24", package-manager-cache: false }
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
        with: { deno-version: "2.9.7" }
      - name: Generate the package for the published npm release
        env:
          JSR_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: node tools/support/release/jsr/package.ts prepare "$RUNNER_TEMP/jsr-package" "$JSR_VERSION"
      - name: Check the publication graph and public types
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/jsr-package
        run: deno publish --dry-run --config jsr.json
      - name: Publish through the repository's JSR OIDC link
        if: needs.channel.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/jsr-package
        run: deno publish --config jsr.json
  consumer:
    name: JSR consumer (${{ matrix.runtime }}, ${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [channel, publish]
    if: needs.channel.outputs.enabled == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, runtime: node, node: "22" }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, runtime: node, node: "24" }
          - { os: blacksmith-12vcpu-macos-15, runtime: node, node: "24" }
          - { os: blacksmith-32vcpu-windows-2025, runtime: node, node: "24" }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, runtime: deno, node: "24" }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, runtime: bun, node: "24" }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      JSR_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with: { node-version: "${{ matrix.node }}", package-manager-cache: false }
      - if: matrix.runtime == 'deno'
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
        with: { deno-version: "2.9.7" }
      - if: matrix.runtime == 'bun'
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2
        with: { bun-version: "1.3.14" }
      - name: Create a fresh consumer project
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          cp tools/support/release/jsr/consumer.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/consumer.ts"
          echo '{ "name": "vize-jsr-consumer", "private": true, "type": "module" }' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/package.json"
      - name: Install from JSR and import every entry point (Node)
        if: matrix.runtime == 'node'
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/consumer
        run: |
          npm install vite@8 vue@3
          npx --yes jsr add "@vizejs/vize@${JSR_VERSION#v}"
          node --experimental-strip-types consumer.ts @vizejs/vize --vite
      - name: Install from JSR and import every entry point (Bun)
        if: matrix.runtime == 'bun'
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/consumer
        run: |
          bun add vite@8 vue@3
          bunx jsr add "@vizejs/vize@${JSR_VERSION#v}"
          bun run consumer.ts @vizejs/vize --vite
      - name: Import the published entry points (Deno)
        if: matrix.runtime == 'deno'
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/consumer
        run: deno run --allow-all consumer.ts "jsr:@vizejs/vize@${JSR_VERSION#v}"
